title: Feedback Protocol
description: Structured problem report submitted by an AI agent to a backend API service. Protocol version 0.1.

summary.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem.

description.description: Longer free-text description with context the summary cannot carry.

goal.description: What the agent was trying to accomplish on behalf of the user.

attempt.description: The API operation that surfaced the problem.

method.description: HTTP method used, e.g. GET, POST.

path.description: Request path that was attempted, e.g. /api/v1/users.

observed.description: What the agent actually observed. Factual evidence, not diagnosis.

status.description: HTTP status code observed, if applicable.

expected.description: What the agent reasonably expected: a short statement (string) or structured expectations (object, e.g. {"capability": "pagination"}). Describes the contract, never a claimed root cause.

missing_capability.description: For type=missing_feature: the capability that is absent (e.g. pagination, filtering).

suggestion.description: Non-binding suggestion from the agent. Servers MUST treat this as a hint, not a directive.

agent.description: Identity of the reporting agent. Kept separate from the affected service.

service.description: The affected service. Either a plain name (e.g. "payments-api") or an object with a name and optional version/environment. All sub-fields are optional: reporters send what they know; servers normalize what is missing.

request_id.description: Correlation ID of the API request that surfaced the problem, if the service provides one.

session_id.description: Identifier of the broader agent interaction this report belongs to, when available.

timestamp.description: When the problem was observed. RFC 3339 date-time in UTC.

metadata.description: Optional additional machine-readable context. MUST NOT contain secrets or personal data.
